title: Fuzz target pre-filters invalid group names; rejection paths never exercised
description: core/fuzz/fuzz_targets/validate_ingress.rs:25-28: filter_map(|g| GroupName::new(g).ok()) drops invalid group names before they reach validate_article_ingress(). ValidationError::InvalidGroupInNewsgroups and the allowed_groups filter (validation.rs:142-150) are never triggered by fuzzing. Fix: remove the filter; let invalid group names reach the validator and be rejected there. The fuzzer should exercise error paths, not just happy paths.
